items.raw_excerpt: 模型参数规模不断突破，推理成本持续下降，开源生态日益繁荣。当模型能力逐渐成为行业共识，一个新的问题开始浮现： 当人人都能获得强大的模型能力之后，真正的竞争力还剩下什么？ 答案正在从模型能力本身，转向围绕模型构建可规模化的智能系统；从单点能力提升，转向系统工程与组织级落地能力。

title_i18n.zh: 从工具调用到生产级 Data Agent：Context 与治理闭环｜AICon深圳
title_i18n.en: From tool calling to production-grade Data Agents: Context and governance closed loop | AICon Shenzhen
title_i18n.es: De la llamada a herramientas al Data Agent de producción: Context y bucle cerrado de gobernanza | AICon Shenzhen

excerpt_i18n.zh: 模型参数规模不断突破，推理成本持续下降，开源生态日益繁荣。当模型能力逐渐成为行业共识，一个新的问题开始浮现： 当人人都能获得强大的模型能力之后，真正的竞争力还剩下什么？ 答案正在从模型能力本身，转向围绕模型构建可规模化的智能系统；从单点能力提升，转向系统工程与组织级落地能力。
excerpt_i18n.en: Model parameter scales continue to break records, inference costs keep falling, and the open-source ecosystem is thriving. As model capabilities gradually become industry consensus, a new question has emerged: once everyone has access to powerful models, what is left of true competitiveness? The answer is shifting from model capabilities themselves to building scalable intelligent systems around models—and from single-point capability improvements to systems engineering and organization-level implementation.
excerpt_i18n.es: La escala de los parámetros de los modelos no deja de batir récords, los costes de inferencia siguen bajando y el ecosistema de código abierto es cada vez más próspero. Cuando la capacidad de los modelos se convierte gradualmente en un consenso del sector, empieza a surgir una nueva pregunta: cuando todo el mundo puede acceder a capacidades de modelos potentes, ¿qué queda como verdadera ventaja competitiva? La respuesta está pasando de la capacidad del modelo en sí a la construcción de sistemas inteligentes escalables en torno al modelo; de la mejora de capacidades puntuales a la ingeniería de sistemas y la capacidad de implementación a nivel organizativo.

items.title: GPT-5.6 当老板：买假用户、被Chrome干崩3小时，烧掉3亿Token收入却为0
items.raw_excerpt: 为了让 Agent 完成现实世界中的工作，仅让它运行几分钟或几小时显然不够。它需要连续工作数天甚至数周，同时还要获得企业资产和运营资金。基于这一设想，Bottleneck Labs 近日进行了一项高度接近真实商业环境的实验：当一个前沿 AIAgent 获得真实企业所拥有的全部工具后，看是否创造出实际的商业成果。

title_i18n.zh: GPT-5.6 当老板：买假用户、被Chrome干崩3小时，烧掉3亿Token收入却为0
title_i18n.en: GPT-5.6 as Boss: Bought fake users, got crashed by Chrome for 3 hours, burned 300 million tokens, yet revenue is 0.
title_i18n.es: GPT-5.6 como jefe: compró usuarios falsos, Chrome lo tumbó durante 3 horas, quemó 300 millones de tokens y los ingresos fueron 0.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 为了让 Agent 完成现实世界中的工作，仅让它运行几分钟或几小时显然不够。它需要连续工作数天甚至数周，同时还要获得企业资产和运营资金。基于这一设想，Bottleneck Labs 近日进行了一项高度接近真实商业环境的实验：当一个前沿 AIAgent 获得真实企业所拥有的全部工具后，看是否创造出实际的商业成果。
excerpt_i18n.en: To enable an Agent to handle real-world work, running it for just a few minutes or hours is clearly insufficient. It needs to operate continuously for days or even weeks, while also gaining access to enterprise assets and operating capital. Based on this vision, Bottleneck Labs recently conducted an experiment in a highly realistic business environment: when a cutting-edge AI Agent is given all the tools available to a real company, can it actually generate tangible business results?
excerpt_i18n.es: Para que un agente pueda realizar trabajos en el mundo real, no basta con hacerlo funcionar durante unos minutos u horas. Necesita trabajar de forma continua durante días e incluso semanas, además de obtener activos empresariales y capital operativo. Partiendo de esta idea, Bottleneck Labs llevó a cabo recientemente un experimento muy cercano a un entorno empresarial real: cuando un agente de IA de vanguardia dispone de todas las herramientas que posee una empresa real, ver si es capaz de generar resultados comerciales reales.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, IDC released the *IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Foundation Model Software 2026 Vendor Assessment*. A total of 11 vendors worldwide were evaluated, and Alibaba Cloud was named a Leader in the quadrant thanks to its Qwen model family and Qwen AI platform. It was the only Chinese vendor to enter this quadrant, sharing the top tier with Google, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Amazon.

IDC noted that by 2026, the world has entered an era of multi-model, multi-agent, multimodal, and autonomous execution. Unlike single-dimensional model benchmarks, this assessment focused on the combined competitiveness of “model capability + service capability.”

At the model layer, IDC pointed out that the Qwen large model family adopts a unified MoE architecture and pretraining paradigm, offering a full range of sizes from lightweight to Max, with capabilities in reasoning, coding, and multilingual tasks. It has launched dozens of self-developed models in text generation, reasoning, multimodal understanding, multimodal generation, and specialized tasks.

At the model service layer, Alibaba Cloud provides a rich set of large language models, multimodal models, and scenario-optimized models, along with a complete toolchain for data processing, fine-tuning, evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and application building and deployment.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Not long ago, a media friend told me about a scene he witnessed at an event. The reporter sitting to his right had an AI voice recorder and an AI assistant on his computer open at the same time. Before the interview even ended, the materials were already being organized. The reporter sitting to his left, however, was still taking notes by hand with a pen and notebook, planning to type them into Word after returning. The two sat in the same event, but seemed to be from two different eras.

Over the past six months, based on observations of my own colleagues and media friends, the differences in how deeply people use AI are now enormous. Some have already reached a level close to "mastery." From topic research, interview preparation, and audio transcription to meeting notes, article structure, and headline generation, AI has penetrated almost every step of content production. But other journalists are still using the same working methods as ten years ago: manual notes, manual organization, and then opening Word to write character by character.

What can this knowledge base teach content creators?
